import json,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
S=Path('/home/user/src/work-leaf/bench-results/efficiency-mechanism-isolation-20260906T214448Z')
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
canon=lambda x:json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()
sp=S/'CANDIDATE-COMMON-ACCOUNTING-SUPPLEMENT-SCOPE.json'
scope_sha='6a584d5ae86688ec7fd832e5db23a6eca9abb83bb77379828129118e23f1d831'
assert sha(sp.read_bytes())==scope_sha
scope=json.loads(sp.read_bytes());refs={str(sp):scope_sha}
def visit(x):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  if set(('path','sha256'))<=x.keys():refs[x['path']]=x['sha256']
  for v in x.values():visit(v)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for v in x:visit(v)
visit(scope)
frozen=json.loads(Path(scope['helper_identity_manifest']['path']).read_bytes())
assert len(frozen['files'])==105
for r in frozen['files']:refs[r['path']]=r['sha256']
old=json.loads(Path(scope['original_accounting']['path']).read_bytes())
for r in old['runs']:
 refs[r['receipt_source']['path']]=r['receipt_source']['sha256']
 refs.update(r['accounting']['source_sha256'])
refs.update(json.loads(Path(scope['eligibility_result']['path']).read_bytes())['source_sha256'])
initial_refs=dict(refs);source_union={};receipts=[]
for original,scoped in zip(old['runs'],scope['rows'],strict=True):
 p=Path(original['receipt_source']['path']).with_name('COMMON-ACCOUNTING-COMPACTION-SUPPLEMENT.json')
 data=p.read_bytes();v=json.loads(data)
 assert v['scope_sha256']==scope_sha and v['original_entry']==original['original_entry']
 assert all(v['original_entry'].get(k)==x for k,x in scoped.items())
 for path,h in v['accounting']['source_sha256'].items():
  assert path not in source_union or source_union[path]==h,path
  source_union[path]=h
  assert path in initial_refs and initial_refs[path]==h,path
 c=v['original_comparison']
 if c['equality_required']:
  assert c['original_source_map_is_identical_subset'] and c['normalized_full_result_sha256_equals_original'] and c['normalized_projection_equals_original']
 checks=v['replay_checks']
 assert checks['returned_sources_endpoint_match'] and checks['all_declared_and_frozen_endpoint_match'] and checks['returned_sources_all_prehashed']
 refs[str(p)]=sha(data)
 receipts.append({'run_id':v['original_entry']['run_id'],'path':str(p),'sha256':sha(data),'bytes':len(data)})
for p,h in refs.items():assert sha(Path(p).read_bytes())==h,p
print(json.dumps({'verified_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'declared_and_frozen_source_count_including_scope':len(initial_refs),'all_verified_sources_including_new_receipts':len(refs),'frozen_count':len(frozen['files']),'returned_source_count':len(source_union),'returned_source_inventory_sha256':sha(canon(source_union)),'all_source_inventory_sha256':sha(canon(refs)),'all_source_endpoints_match':True,'all_original_receipts_unchanged':True,'all_scope_inputs_unchanged':True,'all_eight_original_validated_results_equal':True,'receipts':receipts},separators=(',',':')))
